title: Bits and Info.
text: A great tour featuring local specialty foods, snacks, and drinks. It was perfect for what we were looking for, offering a nice mix of historical insights and local information. Our guide was friendly, knowledgeable, and informative.
author: KathyAnn_P

title: Fabulous Tour
text: It was an amazing tour. Our guide was very personable had a lot of good information on Barcelona. He shared a bit of history as we walked in between places as well as personal experiences in Barcelona. We also had a bit a free time to explore the shops and neighborhoods.
author: sherryb684

title: Carla was lovely!
text: Carla was LOVELY! Would recommend to anyone visiting! Lovely experience! Amazing food, wine and fun facts about the city along the way.
author: Stay56116424630

title: Love it
text: Incredible guide!!! Best tour!!!! Tslila is the best. She not only gave us great information about the food, the neighborhood, and the restaurants, she also helped us to make a reservation for the following day at another great restaurant. Would definitely go again!
author: rachelsU8811XN

title: If you can choose a tour do this with Carla!
text:
Carla has a great sense of food and taste!

She is very knowledgeable of all the plates served and is a a food lover herself!

I love her style and passion to serve tasty Catalan food.

Hope to tour with you again!
author: cam19912708

title: Tapas with Tslil!
text: Our local tapas guide, Tslil, did a fantastic job showing us the best of the best local tapas spots. The food and drinks were scrumptious and the company was even better. I can’t wait to go back and try the other tapas spots. Make sure to go hungry and if you can, ask for Tslil!
author: jaybH3712NG

title: They were fantastic
text: They both were so amazing!! Took us everywhere to see new things and talked about everything and answered all the questions we had!!
author: 654shyannt

title: Tasting tapas
text:
Great time spent with family and thanks again to Claire for her culture and knowledge of the different neighborhoods of Barcelona 
I recommend this tour and if luckily you can choose your guide ask CLAIRE 
She's really great.
author: Z8523RCsylvainl

title: Tapas tour in Barcelona
text: We always book a food tour to learn about the culture in the country we visit. This tour hosted by Carla was excellent. The food was delicious and our tour guide Carla was extremely knowledgeable and friendly. When we come back we will definitely be reaching out to Carla to reconnect for dinner. 10/10
author: 59taylort

title: Best tour ever!!
text: Carla was an incredible guide through Catalan cuisine!!! We came hungry and were not disappointed—we tried many traditional items including meats, cheeses, seafood, drinks, dessert and more!! Everyone at the market seemed to know and love Carla, which was an added bonus!! Thanks again!
author: Passport56996258657
